name: circle_atlas
display: The Circle Atlas (H_hat_RB and the Complete Shape of Mathematics)
summary: Runs the viewports, reports where each enters and leaves the circle, and lists what is not yet mapped.

provenance.origin: Cody, 2026-11-16: 'The Circle Atlas: H_hat_RB and The Complete Shape of Mathematics'. A mapping algorithm, not a fit: every viewport is run to a circle (TO: enter fixed-point space) and from a circle (FROM: exit), the fibre of choices is measured, each carries a pi route. Built on the sedenion battery (FourthAgePapers/TheInterface/02, 03) and reuses tier8_sedenion, box_kite, hypergon_constructibility. Whether FROM maps and the fixed-point-space reading are the project's meaning is THEORETICAL; each viewport's closure is ESTABLISHED numerics.

constants.role: 2 x first positive zero of the cosine power series, via modules.pi_derivations

environment.native_space: the unit circle in C and its images; sedenion imaginary axes
environment.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction exact; float only at output boundary
